description: Search a curated directory of muralists and street artists in Europe. Filter by country, city/region and style (e.g. abstract, figurative, lettering, photorealistic, geometric). Returns matching artists with portfolio highlights and profile URLs. Use this when someone wants to find, hire, or commission a mural artist.

country.description: Country, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code ('DE') or its Dutch name ('Duitsland'). By default matches where the artist is BASED.

include_travel.description: With `country`: also return artists who will WORK there without being based there (they named the country, said 'all of Europe', or have a current or upcoming travel period there).

limit.description: Maximum number of artists to return (1-10).

query.description: Free text over name, tagline, bio, city and styles.

region.description: City, province or region the artist is based in, e.g. 'Rotterdam', 'Noord-Holland', 'Berlin'. Matches city or region.

style.description: Style label, e.g. abstract, figurative, lettering, photorealistic, geometric.

name: search_muralists

city.description: City the artist is based in.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country the artist is based in.

id.description: Stable public identifier (the profile slug). Pass to get_muralist_profile.

profile_url.description: Absolute canonical URL of the public profile page.

styles.description: Style labels, e.g. lettering, abstract, figurative.

summary.description: One-line description of the artist's work.

total_matches.description: How many artists matched before the limit was applied.

title: Search muralists
